Authors: Hye-Jung Yoon, Juno Kim, Yesol Park, Jun-Ki Lee, Byoung-Tak Zhang

Predicting Grasping Compliance in Robotic Hands through Analytical-Model-Informed Neural Networks Manipulation

analytical-model-informed neural network grasp compliance underactuated robotic hand forceful tool use physical consistency

简要说明：提出了一种分析模型指导的神经网络（AMINN），结合力学与数据驱动学习，预测欠驱动机械手在外力加载下的抓取顺应性和工具位移。

TLDR: Proposes an analytical-model-informed neural network (AMINN) that combines mechanics with data-driven learning to predict grasp compliance and in-hand tool displacement for underactuated robotic hands under external loading.

Abstract: In robotic manipulation studies, grasping is often treated as a binary success or failure problem, usually defined by whether the object simply stays in the hand. For forceful tool use, however, this view is insufficient because grasp compliance becomes a critical factor governing how the hand and tool behave under load. Compliance arises from coupled kinematics, grasp configuration, passive mechanics, and contact conditions, producing nonlinear behavior in which deformation and interaction forces influence each other. Understanding this relationship is essential for predictive models of how a grasped tool and a compliant hand jointly respond to external loading. In underactuated hands, these effects are amplified: such designs offer low cost and adaptive grasping, but make compliance behavior more difficult to model and predict. Our goal is therefore to develop a predictive model for grasped tool behavior during forceful interactions. To address this challenge, we introduce an analytical model informed neural network (AMINN), a hybrid predictive model that combines an analytical mechanics layer with data driven learning to estimate grasp stability and in hand tool displacement under external loading. The model is evaluated on a three finger underactuated robotic hand and shows strong predictive capability with mechanically meaningful outputs across diverse loading conditions. Compared with a black box multilayer perceptron baseline, AMINN also achieves better energy based physical consistency. Beyond prediction accuracy alone, this framework advances physically interpretable learning for robotic manipulation and supports more reliable, safer, and more trustworthy autonomous tool use in safety critical settings during forceful interaction.

摘要（中文）：在机器人操作研究中，抓取通常被视为一个二元成功或失败问题，其判定标准往往是物体是否简单地保持在手中。然而，对于需要施加力的工具使用场景，这种观点并不充分，因为抓取柔顺性成为控制手部与工具在负载下行为的关键因素。柔顺性源于耦合运动学、抓取构型、被动力学及接触条件，会产生非线性行为——变形与接触力相互影响。理解这一关系对于建立预测模型至关重要，该模型需描述被夹持工具与柔顺手部如何共同响应外部载荷。在欠驱动手中，这些效应被放大：此类设计虽成本低且能自适应抓取，却使柔顺行为的建模与预测更为困难。因此，我们的目标是开发一种在强力交互过程中预测被夹持工具行为的模型。为应对这一挑战，我们提出分析模型引导的神经网络（AMINN），这是一种融合分析力学层与数据驱动学习的混合预测模型，可评估外部载荷下的抓取稳定性及工具在手内的位移。该模型在三指欠驱动机械手上进行了评估，展现出强大的预测能力，能在多种载荷条件下输出具有力学意义的预测结果。与黑箱多层感知机基线模型相比，AMINN在基于能量的物理一致性方面表现更优。除预测精度外，该框架还推动了机器人操作中物理可解释学习的发展，支持在安全关键场景中实现更可靠、更安全且更值得信赖的自主工具使用。

Authors: Qianwen Zhao, Long Wang

Reinforcement Learning: From Algorithms To Foundation Models WorldModel

multi-agent RL world models diffusion-based world models video world models generative models

简要说明：本论文从两个角度研究强化学习：博弈中的多智能体RL，以及基于生成模型/基础模型的RL用于决策，包括基于扩散的世界模型和用于控制的可交互视频世界模型。

TLDR: This thesis studies reinforcement learning from two perspectives: multi-agent RL in games and RL with generative/foundation models for decision making, including diffusion-based world models and video world models for control.

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) provides a framework for sequential decision making under explicit objectives. In its classical form, RL studies how an agent should act to maximise long-term reward in a dynamic environment. In richer settings, the problem extends beyond a single agent and fixed environment: intelligent behavior may require strategic interaction, adaptation to uncertainty, and reasoning over high-dimensional worlds. This thesis studies RL from two perspectives: algorithms in games and RL in the era of foundation models. The first part focuses on multi-agent RL in games. It examines how incentives, policies, and equilibrium concepts interact in competitive and general-sum environments, spanning two-player zero-sum games, large-scale video games, and multi-player settings with general structure. These works investigate learning in multi-agent systems and the behavior of RL methods in interactive environments. The second part studies RL with generative and foundation models, motivated by the idea that prior knowledge can enrich sequential decision making. Pretrained generative models and learned world models serve as representation tools and structured priors for planning, control, and policy optimization. The thesis develops diffusion-based world models, investigates RL for efficient video generation, explores generative models as policy classes, and studies interactive video world models in which actions shape future observations. It also addresses long-horizon modeling through architectures with memory. Together, these contributions present a unified view of RL as objective-driven adaptation in complex sequential domains. From strategic games to generative world models, the thesis highlights how RL connects decision making, environment modeling, and emerging foundation-model capabilities, offering a broader perspective on the principles underlying intelligent behavior.

摘要（中文）：强化学习（RL）为在明确目标下进行序列决策提供了框架。其经典形式研究智能体如何在动态环境中采取行动以最大化长期回报。在更复杂的设定中，问题超越了单一智能体和固定环境：智能行为可能需要策略互动、对不确定性的适应以及在高维世界中的推理。本论文从两个角度研究强化学习：博弈中的算法与基础模型时代的强化学习。 第一部分关注博弈中的多智能体强化学习。它探讨了在竞争与一般和环境中，激励、策略与均衡概念如何相互作用，涵盖两人零和博弈、大规模视频游戏以及具有一般结构的多玩家设定。这些研究考察了多智能体系统中的学习过程以及强化学习方法在交互环境中的行为。第二部分研究基于生成模型与基础模型的强化学习，其动机在于先验知识能够丰富序列决策。预训练生成模型与学习到的世界模型被用作表征工具及用于规划、控制与策略优化的结构化先验。本论文开发了基于扩散的世界模型，研究了用于高效视频生成的强化学习，探索了作为策略类别的生成模型，并研究了动作塑造未来观测的交互式视频世界模型。它还通过具有记忆的架构解决了长时域建模问题。这些贡献共同呈现了强化学习作为复杂序列领域中目标驱动适应的统一视角。从策略博弈到生成世界模型，本论文凸显了强化学习如何将决策制定、环境建模与新兴基础模型能力相连接，为理解智能行为背后的原理提供了更广阔的视角。

Authors: Zihan Ding

Thinking in Video: Can Video Generators Really Reason About the Real World? WorldModel

world models video generation causal reasoning perception-prediction gap auditing

简要说明：本文提出了因果-生成双重裁判（CGDJ）审计，用于评估视频生成模型是否能真正推理现实世界的动态，揭示了看似合理的视频生成与明确因果理解之间的差距。

TLDR: This paper introduces the Causal-Generative Dual-Judge (CGDJ) audit to evaluate whether video generative models can genuinely reason about real-world dynamics, revealing a gap between plausible video generation and explicit causal understanding.

Abstract: Recent advances in world models and video generation have given rise to an emerging reasoning paradigm that leverages video generative models to simulate, predict, and reason about real-world dynamics. We redefine this paradigm as Thinking in Video, where video is not merely an output artifact but a medium for constructing, extending, and verifying causal thought. However, this promise remains unverified: convincing rollouts may reflect memorized appearances rather than causal understanding, while existing metrics separate perceptual fidelity from semantic logic. To evaluate whether video generators support such reasoning, we introduce the Causal-Generative Dual-Judge (CGDJ), auditing World Model Consistency from two perspectives. Explicit Causal Perception tests whether a generator reads a video scenario as a reasoning problem through spatio-temporal flattened visual question answering, while Implicit Generative Perception-Prediction Gap evaluates whether it renders the causal consequence as a consistent future video. Applying CGDJ to representative open- and closed-source generators reveals a clear Perception-Prediction Gap: open-source models produce plausible dynamics despite near-zero explicit causal perception, whereas advanced closed-source systems show stronger but still limited alignment between reasoning and generation. Further analysis exposes audio-visual misalignment, where models verbalize correct causal logic more reliably than they render it, challenging the "world simulator" narrative.

摘要（中文）：世界模型与视频生成的最新进展催生了一种新兴的推理范式，该范式利用视频生成模型来模拟、预测和推理现实世界的动态变化。我们将这一范式重新定义为"视频思维"——视频不再仅仅是输出的产物，而是构建、延展和验证因果思维的媒介。然而，这一愿景尚未得到验证：看似合理的推演结果可能反映的是记忆中的表象而非因果理解，而现有评估指标则将感知逼真度与语义逻辑相分离。为评估视频生成器是否真正支持此类推理，我们提出了"因果-生成双裁判"（CGDJ）方法，从两个维度审计世界模型的一致性。显式因果感知测试通过时空展开的视觉问答，检验生成器是否将视频场景解读为推理问题；隐式生成感知-预测差距则评估生成器是否将因果后果呈现为连贯的未来视频。将CGDJ应用于代表性开源与闭源生成器后，我们发现了一个显著的"感知-预测差距"：开源模型虽能生成看似合理的动态变化，但其显式因果感知能力近乎为零；而先进的闭源系统虽展现出更强的因果推理与生成一致性，但仍存在明显局限。进一步分析揭示了视听错位现象——模型在语言化正确因果逻辑时的可靠性高于视觉呈现，这挑战了"世界模拟器"的叙事框架。

Authors: Yongheng Zhang, Guang Yang, Ruihan Hou, Qiguang Chen, Ziang Liu, Xiaolong Liu, Manman Zhang, Yanchao Hao, Zheng Wei, Hao Wu, Libo Qin, Peishan Dai, Yinghui Li, Di Yin, Xing Sun

Generalize and Guide: Decomposing Rewards for Few-Shot Inverse Reinforcement Learning RLRobot

few-shot inverse reinforcement learning multi-task demonstrations reward decomposition navigation manipulation

简要说明：本文提出MPG，一种将奖励分解为可泛化判别器和邻近函数的少样本逆强化学习方法，能从少量演示中学习新任务，在导航和操作任务上取得了优异结果。

TLDR: This paper proposes MPG, a few-shot inverse reinforcement learning method that decomposes rewards into a generalizable discriminator and a proximity function to learn new tasks from limited demonstrations, achieving strong results on navigation and manipulation tasks.

Abstract: Inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) provides a powerful framework for learning from demonstrations. However, real-world tasks often exhibit substantial natural variations (e.g., picking up mugs with varying shapes), making it impractical to collect demonstrations that fully specify a new task under every possible scenario. In practice, while demonstrations for the target task are limited, it is often easier to obtain datasets of heterogeneous but related behaviors. This motivates the problem of few-shot IRL with multi-task demonstrations (FM-IRL), where an agent must learn a new task with substantial variations from only a limited number of target-task demonstrations, together with sufficient demonstrations of related tasks and online agent experience. To do so, we must both recover the expert distribution of the new task and provide guidance when the agent deviates from it. We introduce Multitask discriminator Proximity-Guided IRL (MPG), which learns two complementary reward components: (1) a generalizable discriminator that transfers shared structure across related tasks to identify expert behavior in a new task, and (2) a proximity function that measures how far a state deviates from expert behavior and provides corrective guidance during exploration. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method on multiple challenging navigation and manipulation tasks under significant variations (e.g., object configurations, table layouts, and initial robot poses), achieving an average success rate of 81.2%, outperforming the strongest per-task baseline by an average of 24.7 percentage points.

摘要（中文）：逆强化学习（IRL）为从示范中学习提供了强大的框架。然而，现实任务往往表现出显著的自然变化（例如，抓取形状各异的杯子），这使得在每种可能场景下收集用于完全指定新任务的示范变得不切实际。实践中，虽然目标任务的示范有限，但通常更容易获得异构但相关行为的数据集。这催生了基于多任务示范的少样本逆强化学习（FM-IRL）问题：智能体必须仅依靠有限的目标任务示范，结合充足的相关任务示范和在线智能体经验，来学习具有显著变化的新任务。为此，我们既要恢复新任务的专家分布，又要在智能体偏离该分布时提供引导。我们提出了多任务鉴别器邻近引导逆强化学习（MPG），该方法学习两个互补的奖励组成部分：（1）可泛化的鉴别器，它能够跨相关任务传递共享结构，以识别新任务中的专家行为；（2）邻近函数，用于衡量状态偏离专家行为的程度，并在探索过程中提供修正性引导。我们在多个具有显著变化（如物体配置、桌面布局和机器人初始姿态）的高难度导航与操作任务上验证了该方法的有效性，平均成功率达到81.2%，比最优的逐任务基线平均高出24.7个百分点。

SLAM in Low-Light Environments: Project Report Perception3D

简要说明：该报告在低光序列上基准测试了纯RGB SLAM系统，发现只有结合IMU融合和全局优化的Kimera-VIO能跟踪所有序列，而经典单目方法会失败。

TLDR: This report benchmarks RGB-only SLAM systems on low-light sequences, finding that only Kimera-VIO (with IMU fusion and global optimization) tracks all sequences, while classical monocular pipelines fail.

Abstract: Simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) is one of the fundamental problems in robotics, as it enables autonomous operations in real-world scenarios. Under low illumination, reduced contrast, sensor noise, and motion blur degrade both feature extraction and feature matching, while compensating with LiDAR, depth, or thermal sensors raises cost, power draw, and integration complexity. Existing benchmarks remain dominated by well-lit indoor or daylight sequences, leaving open how far SLAM with standard RGB cameras can be pushed in the dark. We benchmark six systems spanning the feature-based, direct, filter-based, and learning-based paradigms - ORB-SLAM3, DSO, Kimera-VIO, OpenVINS, DPVO, and DPV-SLAM - on five LaMARia sequences of varying difficulty and illumination, reporting absolute and relative pose error alongside control-point recall. Kimera-VIO is the only system to track all five sequences to completion, combining the lowest relative pose error with steadily growing absolute error due to the absence of loop closure; DPVO and DPV-SLAM never lose tracking but incur absolute errors of roughly 100 m under low light; and the classical monocular pipelines (ORB-SLAM3, DSO) together with the filter-based OpenVINS fail outright or diverge on most of the harder and low-light sequences. The results suggest that RGB-only SLAM maintains stable low-light tracking only when both inertial fusion and global optimization are present. Closing the remaining gap will likely require low-light-specific learned front-ends or a return to complementary sensing.

摘要（中文）：同时定位与地图构建（SLAM）是机器人学的基本问题之一，它使自主系统能够在真实场景中运行。在低光照条件下，对比度降低、传感器噪声和运动模糊会同时削弱特征提取与特征匹配的效果，而采用激光雷达、深度传感器或热成像仪进行补偿则会增加成本、功耗及系统集成复杂度。现有基准测试仍以光照充足的室内或白天场景为主，尚未明确标准RGB相机在黑暗中能将SLAM推进到何种程度。我们基于五种难度与光照条件各异的LaMARia序列，对涵盖基于特征、直接法、滤波法与学习范式的六种SLAM系统——ORB-SLAM3、DSO、Kimera-VIO、OpenVINS、DPVO和DPV-SLAM——进行了基准测试，报告了绝对位姿误差、相对位姿误差以及控制点召回率。在所有系统中，仅Kimera-VIO成功完成了全部五个序列的追踪，其相对位姿误差最低，但因缺乏闭环检测导致绝对误差持续增长；DPVO与DPV-SLAM从未丢失追踪，但在低光照下绝对误差约达100米；而经典单目管线（ORB-SLAM3、DSO）及基于滤波法的OpenVINS在大部分困难与低光序列中完全失效或发散。结果表明，仅依赖RGB的SLAM只有在惯性融合与全局优化同时存在时，才能维持稳定的低光追踪。要弥合现有差距，可能需要开发针对低光环境的学习型前端，或回归互补感知方案。

Authors: Oleh Basystyi, Anna Stasyshyn, Oleksandr Kosovan, Yaroslav Prytula

Stability and Comfort in Mobile Robot-Pedestrian Interactions Locomotion

socially aware navigation nonholonomic mobile robots Social Force Model pedestrian comfort stability analysis

简要说明：本文为非完整移动机器人开发了基于社会力模型和碰撞时间社会力模型的社交感知导航算法，并进行了稳定性证明和人类舒适度实验。

TLDR: This paper develops socially aware navigation algorithms for nonholonomic mobile robots using Social Force and Time-to-Collision Social Force Models, with stability proofs and human comfort experiments.

Abstract: Mobile robots in public spaces must ensure pedestrians' comfort, and yet empirical studies of walkers' subjective safety are rare. Many classical navigation algorithms do not distinguish the walkers from dynamic obstacles and do not explicitly model subjective human factors. Moreover, most studies focus on holonomic mobile robots, whereas applications demand Nonholonomic Mobile Robots (NMR). This paper develops socially aware algorithms for NMRs, proves the stability, verifies the performance experimentally, and statistically analyzes the reported comfort. We design a framework for NMRs using Social Force Model (SFM) and the projected Time-to-collision Social Force Model (TSFM). We formalize the NMR-pedestrians' and NMR-obstacles' interactions and prove the system's stability, assuming boundedly nonpassive pedestrians. Simulations calibrate the models by maximizing a hybrid cost function of comfort and speed. Pedestrian-robot interaction experiments compare SFM and TSFM to two remote-controlled baselines and collect walkers' reported comfort. Statistical tools analyze survey results collected during the experiments. Benchmarking the algorithms against previous studies highlights the proposed methods' advantage with respect to the studied metrics. Overall, the models are stable and improve pedestrian comfort when an NMR navigates through a pedestrian crowd.

摘要（中文）：公共空间中的移动机器人必须保障行人的舒适感，然而关于步行者主观安全性的实证研究仍十分罕见。许多经典导航算法未能将行人区别于动态障碍物，也未明确建模主观人因要素。此外，多数研究聚焦于全向移动机器人，而实际应用需求却指向非完整约束移动机器人（NMR）。本文针对非完整约束移动机器人开发了具有社会感知能力的算法，证明了其稳定性，通过实验验证了性能，并对报告舒适度进行了统计分析。我们基于社会力模型（SFM）和投影碰撞时间社会力模型（TSFM）设计了非完整约束移动机器人的算法框架。我们形式化描述了非完整约束移动机器人-行人及非完整约束移动机器人-障碍物的交互关系，并在假设行人具有有界非被动性的条件下证明了系统的稳定性。通过最大化包含舒适度与速度的混合代价函数，仿真实验对模型进行了校准。在行人-机器人交互实验中，我们将SFM与TSFM两种模型与两个遥控基准方案进行对比，并收集了步行者报告的舒适度数据。采用统计工具分析了实验期间收集的问卷调查结果。将算法与既往研究进行基准测试，突显了所提方法在各项评估指标上的优势。总体而言，所提模型具有稳定性，能够有效提升非完整约束移动机器人在行人群体中穿行时行人的舒适度。

Authors: Alireza Jafari, Hong-Son Nguyen, Yen-Chen Liu

PGN: Design and Implementation of a Vision-Language Navigation System Based on Pangu Multimodal Foundation Model VLN

Vision-Language Navigation multimodal foundation model Q-Former LoRA action prediction

简要说明：该论文提出PGN，一种视觉语言导航系统，通过Q-Former对齐和LoRA适配器微调OpenPangu-7B，从视觉-语言输入中预测专家动作。

TLDR: The paper presents PGN, a Vision-Language Navigation system that fine-tunes OpenPangu-7B using Q-Former alignment and LoRA adapters to predict expert actions from visual-language inputs.

Abstract: Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) requires an embodied agent to interpret a natural-language instruction and predict actions from temporally ordered visual observations. Adapting a multimodal large language model to VLN requires visual-language alignment, compact temporal inputs, action-space grounding, and stable training on the target hardware. This technical report presents PGN (Pangu Navigator), an offline VLN action-prediction system built on OpenPangu-7B. Training proceeds in two stages. First, PGMM aligns a frozen EVA-ViT-G/14 vision encoder with the frozen language backbone by training a Q-Former and a two-layer MLP projector. Second, PGN adapts the aligned model to expert navigation trajectories using five-observation windows, epoch-dependent temporal sampling, and a reasoning-then-action output format; this stage freezes the aligned visual pathway and updates three structural-token embeddings and LoRA adapters. The implementation combines mixed-precision computation, selective FP32 computation, and DeepSpeed ZeRO-2 on eight Ascend 910B NPUs. Under teacher-forced, open-loop evaluation on 500 held-out expert trajectories, V9 reports a 62.29% Normalized Action Match (NAM) and a 100.00% Non-empty Rate (NER). These metrics quantify offline expert-action alignment rather than closed-loop navigation success; evaluating error accumulation, path efficiency, and goal completion remains future work.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言导航（VLN）要求具身智能体理解自然语言指令，并根据时间顺序的视觉观测预测动作。将多模态大语言模型适配至VLN任务需要视觉-语言对齐、紧凑的时间输入处理、动作空间 grounding 以及在目标硬件上进行稳定训练。本技术报告提出PGN（盘古导航器），这是一个基于OpenPangu-7B构建的离线VLN动作预测系统。训练分为两个阶段：第一阶段，PGMM通过训练Q-Former和两层MLP投影器，将冻结的EVA-ViT-G/14视觉编码器与冻结的语言骨干网络对齐；第二阶段，PGN采用五观测窗口、基于epoch的时间采样以及“推理-动作”输出格式，将对齐后的模型适配至专家导航轨迹。此阶段冻结对齐后的视觉通路，并更新三个结构化词元嵌入与LoRA适配器。实现中混合了混合精度计算、选择性FP32计算以及在八块Ascend 910B NPU上部署的DeepSpeed ZeRO-2。在500条保留的专家轨迹上采用教师强制开环评估时，V9版本报告了62.29%的归一化动作匹配率（NAM）和100.00%的非空率（NER）。这些指标衡量的是离线专家动作对齐程度，而非闭环导航成功率；误差累积、路径效率及目标完成度的评估仍有待未来工作。

Authors: Li Xian, Mingxi Li, Yizheng Wang, Yiming Shen, Qi Chen, Zhuoling Xiao

RayOcc: Occlusion-Aware Ray Occupancy Estimation via Gaussian Mixture Intensity Perception3D

3D semantic occupancy prediction occlusion-aware Gaussian mixture intensity Poisson event formulation camera-only

简要说明：RayOcc提出了一种通过高斯混合强度和泊松事件公式实现的遮挡感知射线占据模型，用于预测每条射线的多标签占据情况，在nuScenes基准上达到了基于高斯占据方法的当前最优结果。

TLDR: RayOcc proposes an occlusion-aware ray occupancy model using Gaussian mixture intensity and Poisson event formulation to predict multi-label occupancy per ray, achieving state-of-the-art results on nuScenes for camera-only 3D semantic occupancy prediction.

Abstract: Camera-only 3D semantic occupancy prediction aims to infer voxel-wise scene semantics from multi-view images, yet remains fundamentally challenging due to depth ambiguity and occlusion. Along a single camera ray, multiple spatially separated surfaces may coexist, making occupancy inherently a multi-label existence problem rather than a single-depth estimation task. However, most existing approaches favor a single dominant depth hypothesis per ray, limiting their ability to model volumetric scenes under complex occlusion. To address this limitation, we introduce RayOcc, an occlusion-aware ray occupancy framework that reformulates ray modeling as multi-label existence prediction. Instead of predicting a categorical depth distribution, RayOcc estimates a non-normalized Gaussian mixture intensity along each ray and converts it into interval-wise occupancy probabilities via a Poisson event formulation, allowing multiple occupied hypotheses to coexist without enforcing mutual competition across depth. The predicted mixture components are interpreted as occupancy hypotheses to initialize sparse 3D Gaussian primitives, which are refined and rasterized for semantic occupancy prediction. Experiments on the nuScenes benchmark show that RayOcc achieves state-of-the-art overall IoU and mIoU among the compared Gaussian-based occupancy methods.

摘要（中文）：纯视觉三维语义占据预测旨在从多视角图像中推断体素级别的场景语义，但由于深度模糊性和遮挡问题，该任务仍面临根本性挑战。沿单条相机光线可能存在多个空间分离的表面，这使得占据预测本质上是一个多标签共存问题，而非单一深度估计任务。然而，现有方法大多倾向于为每条光线假设一个主导深度，限制了其在复杂遮挡条件下建模体素场景的能力。为解决这一局限，我们提出RayOcc——一种遮挡感知的光线占据框架，将光线建模重新定义为多标签共存预测任务。RayOcc不预测分类深度分布，而是沿每条光线估计非归一化的高斯混合强度，并通过泊松事件公式将其转换为区间级别的占据概率，使得多个占据假设能够共存而无需在深度维度上相互竞争。预测出的混合分量被解释为占据假设，用于初始化稀疏三维高斯基元，随后通过优化和栅格化实现语义占据预测。在nuScenes基准上的实验表明，在基于高斯方法的占据预测模型中，RayOcc实现了最优的整体交并比和平均交并比。

Authors: Junho Kim, Seongwon Lee

FlashRT: Agent Harness for Guiding Agents to Deploy Real-Time Multimodal Applications WorldModel

real-time multimodal serving world model deployment agent-driven optimization multi-GPU parallelism video generation

简要说明：FlashRT 是一个智能体框架，指导编码智能体自动优化和部署实时多模态应用（例如视频世界模型和多模态大语言模型）到多 GPU 系统上，通过迭代地转换、验证和基准测试参考实现来实现。

TLDR: FlashRT is an agent harness that guides coding agents to automatically optimize and deploy real-time multimodal applications (e.g., video world models and multimodal LLMs) onto multi-GPU systems by iteratively transforming, validating, and benchmarking reference implementations.

Abstract: Real-time multimodal applications, including voice agents and interactive video generation, compose heterogeneous models into pipelines whose efficient deployment requires application-specific decisions about placement, streaming, and intra-model parallelism. Existing serving systems and auto-parallelism compilers commit to limited transformations and fixed workload assumptions, so achieving high performance on a new application requires hand-crafting an efficient implementation. We present FlashRT, an agent harness that guides coding agents to lift simple developer-written reference implementations into optimized multi-GPU deployments that flexibly weigh target metrics like latency and throughput. Using a new chain-of-program paradigm, FlashRT directs a generic coding agent through a multi-pass transformation process where an agent transforms the reference into an intermediate representation (IR) to capture data dependencies and persistent-state scopes, validates this IR via a sequential interpreter, and performs static analyses to identify candidate transformations. Then, the agent iteratively implements, verifies, and benchmarks each candidate under a measurement-gated optimization loop to produce effective deployments that span different hardware budgets. Across various applications, including video world models and multimodal LLMs, FlashRT converts reference implementations into highly efficient deployments, delivering up to ~70x latency reduction and 2.8x throughput improvement on NVIDIA B200 GPUs. On AMD MI355X GPUs, FlashRT matches the peak latency reduction while increasing peak throughput improvement to 3.6x, demonstrating that agent-driven optimization can be more scalable on platforms with less mature expert optimization. In fact, for Qwen3-Omni text-to-audio inference, FlashRT reduces response latency by 65% compared to the expert vLLM-Omni implementation on AMD MI355X.

摘要（中文）：实时多模态应用，包括语音智能体和交互式视频生成，将异构模型组合成流水线，其高效部署需要针对具体应用做出关于放置、流式传输和模型内并行性的决策。现有的服务系统和自动并行编译器局限于有限的转换方式和固定的工作负载假设，因此要在一个新应用上获得高性能，需要手工制作高效的实现方案。我们提出FlashRT，这是一种智能体框架，它引导编码智能体将简单的开发者编写参考实现提升为优化的多GPU部署，并灵活权衡延迟与吞吐量等目标指标。通过采用新的程序链范式，FlashRT引导通用编码智能体执行多轮转换流程：智能体将参考实现转换为中间表示以捕获数据依赖性和持久状态范围，通过顺序解释器验证此中间表示，并执行静态分析以识别候选转换。随后，智能体在测量门控优化循环中迭代实现、验证并对每个候选方案进行基准测试，从而生成适配不同硬件预算的高效部署。在各种应用中，包括视频世界模型和多模态大语言模型，FlashRT将参考实现转化为高效部署，在NVIDIA B200 GPU上实现了高达约70倍的延迟降低和2.8倍的吞吐量提升。在AMD MI355X GPU上，FlashRT保持了同等峰值延迟降低幅度，同时将峰值吞吐量提升幅度增至3.6倍，这表明在专家优化成熟度较低的平台，智能体驱动的优化可具备更高扩展性。事实上，针对Qwen3-Omni文本到音频推理任务，FlashRT在AMD MI355X上相比专家级vLLM-Omni实现可降低65%的响应延迟。
